Remark
[Estimates for derivatives of any order] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0171 ↗ thm:chow-iii-kappa-scaled-derivative-estimates 1. ch20:20.18\group Derivative Estimates

For every $\ell ,m\ge 0$ there is $\eta (\kappa ,\ell ,m,n)$ such that \[ |\partial _t^\ell \nabla ^mR| \le \eta (\kappa ,\ell ,m,n)R^{1+\ell +m/2}. \] The same scale-invariant estimate holds for any ordering of space and time derivatives of $\Rm $, $\Ric $, or $R$.
